description: This file defines a LocationCaptureManager class responsible for retrieving location data on Android devices, supporting both cached and current locations with permission and provider checks.

classes.name: LocationCaptureManager
classes.description: A class managing location requests, permissions, and caching to provide location data efficiently.

classes.name: LocationCaptureManager.Payload
classes.description: A data class encapsulating the JSON payload of location data.

methods.name: getLocation
methods.description: Suspends to retrieve the current or cached location based on parameters, returning a JSON payload.

methods.name: bestLastKnown
methods.description: Fetches the most recent valid last known location from cache considering maximum age.

methods.name: requestCurrent
methods.description: Requests a fresh location fix with a timeout, using specified providers.
